description:
Job Title: DevOps Software Engineer – Zero Trust ICAM 
 
Job Category: Information Technology 
 
Time Type: Full time 
 
Minimum Clearance Required to Start: TS/SCI with Polygraph 
 
Employee Type: Regular 
 
Percentage of Travel Required: None 
 
Type of Travel: None 
 
 
* * * 
 
 The Opportunity 
 Join a mission-driven team as a Software Engineer supporting DevOps activities for the Zero Trust Identity, Credential, and Access Management (ZT ICAM) program. In this role, you’ll contribute to automated build, test, deployment, monitoring, and release pipelines for enterprise-grade solutions used across diverse DoD environments. You’ll work closely with senior engineers, expand your hands-on Kubernetes and DevOps expertise, and play a key part in delivering secure, scalable systems that support critical national-security operations.
  
 Responsibilities 
 Support the design, development, integration, testing, and maintenance of highly available enterprise web services for an ICAM solution.
 Assist in developing and enhancing automated DevOps pipelines for build, test, packaging, deployment, and monitoring.
 Maintain and improve deployment configurations, documentation, and repeatable processes across customer environments.
 Support Linux-based and containerized environments, including Kubernetes and microservices architectures.
 Contribute to Attribute-Based Access Control services that interface with LDAP directories, REST APIs, and other microservices.
  
 Qualifications: 
 Required: 
 Active TS/SCI clearance with polygraph.
 Bachelor’s degree or higher in computer engineering, computer science, or a related discipline.
 5+ years of software engineering experience.
 2+ years of experience in SIGINT, IA, or IT domains.
 Candidates may substitute 4 additional years of software engineering experience for the degree requirement (total of 9 years).
   
 Desired: 
 Strong proficiency in Java development.
 Experience designing, implementing, and maintaining RESTful services.
 Skilled with Git version control and Maven build tools.
 Comfortable working in Linux environments.
 Experience developing scalable, secure, high-performance applications.
 Ability to write effective unit tests using JUnit/Mock frameworks.
 Experience with GitLab CI/CD pipelines and automated build processes.
 Knowledge of PKI-based authentication and encryption.
 Experience with Docker and Kubernetes container orchestration.
 
 
- 
 
 What You Can Expect: 
  A culture of integrity. 
 At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.
 An environment of trust. 
 CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.
 A focus on continuous growth. 
 Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.
 
 

 Pay Range : 
 There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. At CACI, you will receive comprehensive benefits such as; healthcare, wellness, financial, retirement, family support, continuing education, and time off benefits.
 
 The proposed salary range for this position is: 
$94,400 - $198,200 
 
 
 
 CACI is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic.
